narr: Thunderstorms produced isolated instances of flash flooding in Prince Georges and Montgomery Counties.
ev: The stream gauge on the Northeast Branch Anacostia River at Riverdale rapidly rose above flood stage, cresting at 10.47 feet at 7:10 PM EST. The Northeast Branch Trail was flooded in spots.
Three out of four lanes along with the left shoulder were closed due to high water past Exit 25B/north bound US-1 Baltimore Avenue.
The water level along the Sligo Creek rose above flood stage, cresting at 5.61 feet at 8:25 PM EST on August 9th.
lsr: THREE OUT OF FOUR LANES PLUS THE LEFT SHOULDER OF WESTBOUND I-95/I-495 CAPITAL BELTWAY OUTER LOOP WERE CLOSED DUE TO HIGH WATER PAST EXIT 25B/NORTHBOUND US-1 BALTIMORE AVENUE.
THE STREAM GAUGE ON THE NORTHEAST BRANCH ANACOSTIA RIVER AT RIVERDALE RAPIDLY ROSE ABOVE FLOOD STAGE, WHICH IS 8 FEET, THIS EVENING OVER A PERIOD OF ABOUT 1.5 HOURS DUE TO HEAVY RAINFALL.
